sc-render-smart-button="false" itemscope=""> <section class="article-container" data-stats-ve="35"><h1>Use Gemini Notebook with a work or school Google account</h1><div class="article-content-container"><div class="cc"><p>Most users with a work or school Google Account have access to Gemini Notebook. Feature availability and how your data is handled depends on your license.</p>

<p>For <a href="https://support.google.com/docs/answer/13952129#zippy=%2Cgoogle-workspace-business-plans"><u>Workspace</u></a> and <a href="https://support.google.com/a/answer/16350447?hl=en&amp;visit_id=638899278077862683-351034893&amp;rd=1"><u>Workspace for Education users</u></a> , Gemini Notebook is now a core service (like Gmail, Google Calendar, and Docs).</p>

<h2>How to Upgrade:</h2>

<p>If you want higher limits and additional features with a work or school Google Account, your organization needs to upgrade to a Google Workspace plan that includes higher limits. Contact your Google Workspace administrator to request an upgraded license.<br>
  <br>
  If you’re a Google Workspace administrator, <a href="https://support.google.com/a/answer/15095586"><u>learn how to upgrade your organization’s Google Workspace license</u></a>.</p>

        </td>
        <td>
        <p><span>Your data is protected, and is not used to train Gemini Notebook unless you provide feedback. When you share feedback to help us improve, we may review the full context of that interaction, including your queries, uploads, and the model’s responses. <a href="https://support.google.com/gemininotebook/answer/16179536">Learn more.</a></span></p>

        <p>To ensure safety and reliability, we may process your data to prevent fraud, abuse, and technical issues.&nbsp;</p>
        </td>

        <p>Enterprise-grade security and privacy:</p>

        <p>Your uploaded files, chats and model outputs won’t be reviewed by human reviewers or used to improve generative AI models.</p>

        <p><span>Workspace: Our <a href="https://cloud.google.com/terms/cloud-privacy-notice">Privacy Policy</a> describes how Google Cloud handles your data when you interact with Gemini Notebook.</span></p>

        <p>&nbsp;</p>

        <p><span>Education: The <a href="https://workspace.google.com/terms/education_privacy/#privacy-police-revamp-your-info">Google Workspace for Education Privacy Notice</a> describes how Google Cloud handles your data when you interact with Gemini Notebook. Learn more at the <a href="https://edu.google.com/our-values/privacy-security/">Google Workspace for Education Privacy Center</a>.</span></p>

<h2>Check if you have upgraded access:</h2>

<p>Higher limits and additional features are only available with certain eligible editions. To check if you have expanded excess in the Gemini Notebook app:</p>

<ol>
  <li>Open Gemini Notebook in browser
    <ul>
      <li>Make sure you are signed into your Google work or school account.</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
  <li>At the top, check if you have the distinct Pro, Plus, Expanded, or Ultra badge next to your user profile image. If you find a badge, you have access to higher limits and additional features.</li>
</ol>

<div class="no-margin"><h2>Will my generations contain a watermark?</h2>

<ul>
  <li>All outputs generated in Gemini Notebook using Veo, Omni, or Nano Banana include invisible SynthID watermarks. SynthID identifies AI-generated content by embedding digital watermarks directly into AI-generated content.</li>
  <li>To further help you identify AI-generated content, a visible watermark is added to generated images and videos. Eligible users with Google One AI Pro and Ultra subscriptions can control this with the “Visible watermarking” toggle in the drop-down menu under your profile picture. A visible watermark will be applied automatically if you reside in India, South Korea, or Vietnam.</li>
</ul>
</div>
